purpose.value: Allow a visitor to find catalog items matching a text query.

risk.value: Search failures can hide relevant catalog items.

preconditions.value: The catalog application is available and contains indexed items.

expected_state.value: The catalog search form is visible.
The search input contains the supplied query.
The results region is refreshed for the submitted query.
The results list and query heading are visible.

statement.value: Matching items are shown in the visible results list.

description.value: A non-empty query with at least one known matching catalog item.

evidence.summary: Controlled observation of the page, component, elements, states, and locator candidates.
Accepted bounded observation for element el_search_submit using locator loc_search_submit_role.
Tester-confirmed process purpose, risk, role, preconditions, and expected result.
Controlled reference specification for the public catalog search flow.

excluded_fields.explanation: The POM proposal does not require an environment URL.
Routes are withheld until a repository mapping stage requires them.
Raw source references are not required for architecture synthesis.
Capture timestamps do not affect the first POM proposal.
Content hashes remain local provenance data.
Only confirmed or observed values are authorized.
Free-form notes are excluded from the bounded request.
A synthesis-ready context must not contain blocking open questions.
A synthesis-ready context must not contain unresolved conflicts.

prohibited_claims: Do not claim that generated code has executed successfully.
Do not claim that the proposal is business-correct without human review.
Do not claim that any locator is stable beyond the supplied evidence.
Do not claim that proposed objects fit an uninspected repository.
Do not claim security, privacy, or compliance approval.
Do not invent credential values, repository paths, or source files.

proposal.summary: Represent the catalog page and its reusable search form as separate POM objects with one method per authorized process step.

methods.name: open_catalog
methods.intent: Open the catalog page through the framework navigation boundary.

methods.name: enter_query
methods.intent: Fill the observed search input with symbolic test data.

methods.name: submit_search
methods.intent: Submit the search through the observed Search button.

methods.name: read_results
methods.intent: Expose the visible results state for test-level verification.

fixtures.name: catalog_context
fixtures.purpose: Provide the authorized environment and unauthenticated visitor context without embedding values or secrets.

assertions.intent: Verify the confirmed visible outcome without claiming execution success.

review_reason: Architecture mapping accepted for the reference flow.
